result.title: The Pen is Mightier than the Pixel: Natural Textual Unlearnable Example for Large Vision Language Models
result.summary: The proliferation of Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), trained on vast and often sensitive datasets, raised concerns regarding data privacy and unauthorized usage. Unlearnable Examples (UEs), which subtly perturb training data to mislead the models, have emerged as a promising defense method. This paper presents the first exploration of UEs specifically on LVLMs, which poses unique challenges due to their inherent multimodal nature. We propose a novel text-based perturbation method, Natural Textual Unlearnable Examples (NTUE), which can effectively mislead LVLMs by subtly manipulating the image label, establishing a shortcut between an identity of interest and a separate target, without introducing factual misinformation or affecting readability. Comprehensive experiments compared with traditional UE methods demonstrate the superior performance of NTUE. Our findings show that NTUE achieves a high success rate with a poison rate as low as 5%, underscoring its potential as a practical and robust solution for protecting multimodal data in the era of LVLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 该文首次将「不可学习样本」引入 LVLM 训练数据保护，提出 NTUE：通过在图像标签中植入自然文本，在无关身份与目标之间建立捷径，低至 5% 污染率即可误导模型训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心机制是文本线索取代视觉证据的捷径学习，可能为诊断 LVLM 推理中的视觉旁路、信息坍缩及「模型是否真正使用视觉内容」提供反向线索，可供核查。
